classification: exploratory mechanism-discrimination experiment informed by prior receipt audits; not a blinded cosmological prediction
question: Does a uniform event-history or longest-chain clock acquire Lorentzian time dilation in the supplied layered source family, and can a volume clock do better after an independently calculated temporal quadrature correction?
tips: Nearest golden-orbit coordinate, independently by axis, to (1/2,1/2,1/2) plus/minus beta_target*K*delta*unit_direction/2. Ties choose smallest source label. beta=0 uses one common rest tip.
law_variants: pinned exact Euclidean ball-read graph including same-site waiting
negative control: same population/radius/layers, retain only reads that change at most one coordinate; an axis-only read law, not claimed OPH architecture
clocks: actual dynamic-programming maximum read-edge count between endpoints, independently witnessed as a path with distinct layer-labelled events
fourth root of inclusive moving/rest event-count ratio
volume-clock ratio divided by independently computed finite-layer/continuum geometric correction
reference: For actual endpoint displacement d and T=K*delta, Minkowski tau/T=sqrt(1-(d/T)^2). Four-volume is pi*(T^2-d^2)^2/24. Finite-layer continuous-spatial volume is delta*sum_j volume(ball(x,j*delta) intersect ball(y,(K-j)*delta)). Exact spherical-cap lens formula and independent numerical integration check it.
negative_control_correction: The same Euclidean correction is applied diagnostically to the axis-only graph; it should not repair a different causal law. It is not that graph's own continuum limit.
seed_reason: All graph construction, tip selection, counts and controls are deterministic; no random sample is used.
selection_policy: Retain every scheduled q/law/direction/beta row. Main finite comparison uses q34, target beta 0.25/0.5/0.75, timelike graph-related and unclipped rows; beta0.9 is separately reported as near-cone sensitivity. No row is dropped from the receipt.
conditional_falsifier: Uniform positive tick per retained event/read-edge, calibrated to the rest history, cannot equal proper time for both rest and any moving history if their maximum edge counts both equal K. A relative discrepancy above 5 percent in any beta_target>=0.5 valid row rejects this clock identification. This is not a rejection of all observer-history clocks or of the flat-order continuum theorem.
positive_calibration: The independently integrated Euclidean lens volume must equal pi*(T^2-d^2)^2/24 to relative 1e-10, and beta0 finite-layer volume must equal the exact parity sum. Report whether corrected finite-graph volume-clock median absolute error is below the rank-clock error; no promise or post-hoc change if it fails.
stopping_rule: Complete the fixed 4 q by 2 laws by 3 directions by 5 targets census (rest duplicate rows allowed); stop with a partial receipt if wall time reaches 600 seconds or graph memory threatens shared-host capacity. Never increase q or tune thresholds in this run.
resource_policy: One nice-10 AWS process, BLAS/OMP threads=1, separate ~/codex-observables-20260925/causal. No raw graph arrays saved. Only code, logs, tests, specification and small JSON receipts copied locally. No data file over 100MB on Mac.

no Poisson-sprinkling theorem applied to a layered deterministic order
